tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently attended a university orchestra concert. While you enjoyed the performance greatly, the sound quality at the venue was poor, making it difficult to fully appreciate the music. You would like to provide feedback to the sound engineer, Mr. Bridges, in hopes of improving future events. Write an email to Mr. Bridges.
bullets: Describe what you enjoyed about the concert.
Explain the issue you had with the sound quality.
Suggest ways the venue could improve the sound experience for future concerts.
tasks.subject: Feedback on concert sound quality
